description: VPS-only (vps-6d919042) deployment-readiness workstream for the BMAX dashboard standalone artifact. OBSERVATION/AUDIT mission: it verifies the deployment-readiness gates A-L (see docs/odg-operational/DEPLOYMENT.md, VPS Deployment Readiness Workstream) with objective evidence and one honest state each (PROVEN | PARTIAL | BLOCKED | NOT-EXECUTED | UNKNOWN). It performs NO infrastructure mutation and NO deployment. Target is VPS-only: no cloud migration, no new provider. HUMAN-GATED: not authorized for autonomous execution.

objectives.goal: Verify VPS deployment-readiness gates A-L with objective evidence and honest per-gate states (no automatic promotion).
done_when: A Truth Lock + inventory of the exact service/build currently running on :3000 is recorded.
B persistent data inventoried and release files are explicitly separated from durable runtime data.
C a versioned release layout with an explicit active-version switch is defined.
D build-artifact completeness, runtime paths, Next.js standalone/static assets and runtime-generated liveness are verified.
E service account, least privilege, file permissions, secrets and environment configuration are verified.
F health checks, startup/restart, logs, disk capacity and post-reboot recovery are verified.
G backups, backup integrity, off-release location, restore test and rollback rehearsal are proven.
H reverse proxy, bind address, firewall, ports, DNS and TLS prerequisites are recorded without premature public exposure.
I a staging/preprod rehearsal using the exact candidate artifact is proven.
J end-to-end mission transmission/execution/receipt/validation/ledger is proven on the candidate.
K controlled activation, post-deploy acceptance, monitoring and rollback criteria are defined.
L old-release retention and a separately gated cleanup (only after acceptance) are defined.
Every gate carries objective evidence and exactly one honest state; none is auto-promoted.

authorization.reason: Human-gated: VPS deployment readiness requires an explicit CTO authorization before execution; several gates (G,H,I,K) depend on HOST/HUMAN actions (sudo/systemd/DNS/TLS/backup destination) that cannot be self-authorized.

definition_of_done: All readiness gates A-L carry objective evidence and an honest state.
No gate is promoted to PROVEN without its required evidence.
Release preparation, release acceptance and actual deployment remain SEPARATE states.
completion: Human CTO authorization recorded before any execution.
stop_conditions: Any gate requiring sudo/systemd/DNS/TLS/backup-destination/public-exposure halts for a separate explicit CTO authorization.
rollback: Read-only mission: no state to roll back. Evidence is recorded under runtime/generated and docs/odg-operational/DEPLOYMENT.md.
